name: (ADFS) CDN Integration
description: Rewrites public file URLs to a CDN base URL (CloudFront, BunnyCDN, Cloudflare R2, Fastly, or any generic CDN) with cache-busting, path mapping and MIME filtering, plus provider-aware cache purging (Cloudflare, BunnyCDN, Fastly, CloudFront, generic HTTP PURGE) and a |adfs_cdn_url Twig filter.
project_description: The CDN Integration sub-module of Advanced Filesystem transparently rewrites Drupal's public file URLs to a configured CDN base URL by implementing hook_file_url_alter, so images, attachments and any public:// asset are served from the CDN with no template changes. Rewriting supports an optional path prefix, stripping of the public files path, a MIME-prefix whitelist, glob exclusions and cache-busting (none, file mtime, or a stable path hash). A |adfs_cdn_url Twig filter/function lets templates rewrite a URI, absolute URL or file entity directly. Beyond rewriting it offers provider-aware cache purging for Cloudflare (zone API), BunnyCDN, Fastly, AWS CloudFront (native Signature v4 invalidations, no SDK) and a generic HTTP PURGE/BAN/DELETE endpoint — triggered manually (by URL, Drupal URI or file ID, or purge-everything), automatically on file update/delete, and synchronously or via a cron queue. A credential-test endpoint and a filterable purge log round it out. It works standalone (only core file is required) and every route is gated behind the restricted 'administer advanced_filesystem_cdn' permission.
